result.title: ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes
result.summary: Dynamic driving scene reconstruction has made remarkable strides in recent years by leveraging generative priors, particularly in the quality of novel trajectory rendering. Nevertheless, a significant gap remains between the generated data and real-world sensor observations, severely hindering further improvements in reconstruction fidelity. In this paper, we present ReconDreamer#, a self-evolving framework that synergizes reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, which substantially bridges the gap between synthesized novel trajectory data and recorded real-world observations. Within this self-evolving closed-loop framework, the generative and reconstruction models mutually reinforce each other through iterative refinement, ultimately yielding a significant enhancement in the 3D representation capability of the reconstruction model. Additionally, we introduce a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to further enhance the rendering quality of the reconstruction model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet, and EUVS benchmarks. Specifically on Waymo, at a 6-m lateral shift, ReconDreamer# improves NTA-IoU and NTL-IoU by 8.8% and 3.0%, respectively, and reduces FID by 15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ReconDreamer#，一个用于动态驾驶场景重建的自演化闭环框架，让生成模型与重建模型通过迭代互相增强，并引入基于几何先验的自适应地面模型，在 Waymo、nuScenes 等基准上提升新轨迹渲染与重建质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作目标是驾驶场景的 3D 重建与传感器级渲染保真度，不涉及视觉推理的内部状态、证据获取或停止决策，其中的闭环迭代也仅是数据生成与重建的交替优化，与 LVR 的推理状态更新缺乏可核查的实质联系。
